evidence_chain.link: The patient's presentation with fever and night sweats after valve replacement is consistent with infective endocarditis.
evidence_chain.quote: Presentation: A 43-year-old woman with a history of aortic valve replacement three years ago presented with a 20-day history of fever and night sweats.

evidence_chain.link: The absence of joint complaints in the patient's presentation makes non-infective endocarditis less likely.
evidence_chain.quote: Fever with joint complaints (septic arthritis, endocarditis)

ranked_facts.why: The presence of a new regurgitant murmur with fever is more commonly associated with infective endocarditis (B1) than with non-infective endocarditis (B2), as suggested by the provided knowledge chunks.
